title: Ted Boonthanakit
description: A sleek, sexy, almost Amazonian Princess Leia is Jabba's prize catch and worst nightmare. "Lying on the ground during safari," recalls Ted Boonthanakit, "l'd look up at the sky and wonder: are there really Darth Vaders up there?" Born in Bangkok, Thailand, Boonthanakit spent his formative years in Kenya. Now based in Atlanta, Georgia, he divides his time between comics (MICRA, written by Lamar Waldron), advertising, movie storyboarding and Topps trading card illustrations.
